SqlGuard v1.1.0 makes the first evaluation run and CI adoption substantially
simpler while preserving the v1 specification and command contracts.

## Highlights

- Generate a deterministic, database-agnostic starter specification with
  `sqlguard init`.
- Install Windows and Linux x64 releases with user-local, checksum-verifying
  installers.
- Run SqlGuard directly from GitHub Actions with `xtcsystems/sqlguard@v1` after
  the publication subwave creates the stable major tag.

## Installation

Windows:

```powershell
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xtcsystems/sqlguard/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

Linux:

```bash
curl -fsSLO https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xtcsystems/sqlguard/main/install.sh
bash install.sh
```

The installers download the platform executable and the release checksum
manifest, require exactly one matching SHA-256 entry, and replace the installed
binary only after verification succeeds.

## Expected release assets

- `sqlguard-v1.1.0-win-x64.exe`
- `sqlguard-v1.1.0-linux-x64`
- `sqlguard-v1.1.0-checksums.txt`

The publication subwave must build these artifacts from the core `v1.1.0` tag,
populate the checksum manifest, verify both executables, and only then publish
the GitHub release and stable `v1` action tag.
